verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a GUI terminal emulator with GTK/macOS windowing dependencies (ghostty-comm-3, ghostty-comm-4), and a runtime probe found no remote-control/IPC interface, meaning scripts or agents cannot drive a running instance or invoke it headlessly for CI automation (ghostty-probe-rt-1). libghostty is for embedding terminal emulation in other apps, not for running Ghostty itself headlessly in CI.
